subject: Coordination: hands-on prompt review workshop — POC kickoff & load-test windows
messages:
From: aditya.rao@redwood.com
To: sara.gupta@datasprout.io; ops@datasprout.io
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 16:21:00 -0700
Subject: Coordination: hands-on prompt review workshop — POC kickoff & load-test windows

Hi Sara / DataSprout ops team,

Great to be working together. Per our discovery, we want to run a hands-on prompt review workshop as part of the POC kickoff: the agenda would cover prompt inventory & tagging, routing/structured-output requirements, and a short live load test to validate throughput and latency targets.

To make scheduling practical across your product and infra teams, can you confirm availability for one of these 3 options next week (all times PT):

- Option A: Tue May 11, 9:00–12:00 — full workshop + 30m load test (preferred for EMEA overlap)
- Option B: Wed May 12, 13:00–16:00 — afternoon block, ideal if your infra folks prefer afternoon slots
- Option C: Thu May 13, split session 9:00–11:00 (prompt review) + 14:00–15:00 (load test)

A few logistics notes:
- Please have a 1-page prompt inventory (attached template) uploaded beforehand; we can also collect this during the first 30 minutes.
- For the load test we'll need a single VPN endpoint (or allowlist) and the list of expected concurrency + sample prompts. See attached network_requirements.pdf for ports and egress requirements.
- We typically invite 3–5 contributors from the product team and 1–2 infra/ops contacts.

If you prefer, I can send a calendar invite for Option A and we can adjust.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: prompt_inventory_template.xlsx (spreadsheet), network_requirements.pdf (pdf)
From: sara.gupta@datasprout.io
To: aditya.rao@redwood.com
Cc: ops@datasprout.io, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Coordination: hands-on prompt review workshop — POC kickoff & load-test windows

Thanks Aditya — this looks good. Quick notes from our side:

- Our product leads prefer Option B (Wed May 12 afternoon).
- Our infra lead (Ops) is only available for a short window on Wed 12:00–14:00 PT. They can join the load test but not the full 3-hour block.
- We'll have 4 product contributors and 1 infra contact.

Could we split the session so the product workshop runs 13:00–15:00 and we run a separate load test 15:30–16:00 while infra is present remotely? If that works for you, please confirm and share the allowlist instructions.

Sara
Sara Gupta
Head of Product, DataSprout
sara.gupta@datasprout.io
From: aditya.rao@redwood.com
To: ben.carter@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 09:27:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Coordination: hands-on prompt review workshop — POC kickoff & load-test windows

Team — forwarding DataSprout's update. Short ask: can we support a split session on Wed May 12 with product-first workshop 13:00–15:00 PT and a focused load test 15:30–16:00 PT?

Notes for the run:
- Karthik: need you on the product-run through and structured-output mapping (13:00–15:00). Please prepare 3 example prompt sets we can run through.
- Ben: can you own the invite and include our standard runbook link + host the load test 15:30–16:00?
- Marissa: can you confirm whether we should request a temporary higher throughput quota for the 30m load test? If so, I'll open the ticket.

Also, we should pre-fill the prompt inventory template and ask DataSprout to upload before the workshop; I'll attach the template when I send the calendar invite.

If anyone can't make those times, shout now and we'll propose alternatives.

Thanks — Aditya

- Wed May 12, 13:00–15:00 PT — Hands-on prompt review (Google Meet link in calendar)
- Wed May 12, 15:30–16:00 PT — Load test window (we'll run a short traffic burst from Redwood Dedicated cluster)

- Karthik: share 3 sample prompt sets by EOD Tue May 11 (so we can pre-warm caches).
- Marissa: confirm quota bump request by EOD Tue May 11. If needed I'll escalate.

Confirmed — Wed May 12 works. Ops can join for the 15:30 load test; their engineer will dial in at 15:20 to validate allowlist. We've uploaded a partially completed prompt inventory to the Confluence page (link in calendar).
One small request: during the prompt review we want to flag any prompts that require structured outputs (JSON tables) up front so our API contract team can be looped in quickly. Can Karthik highlight tooling for validating structured outputs in the session?
Looking forward to it.
Sara
